description: This file defines internal data structures, constants, and function prototypes related to report management in a LAN management system. It includes a class structure with various boolean and integer fields for NDS and NDT configurations, as well as function declarations for creating, initializing, and removing report objects.

classes.name: COSA_DATAMODEL_REPORTS
classes.description: Data structure representing report configuration and status, including NDS and NDT parameters, with optional device list for gateway association.

methods.name: CosaReportsCreate
methods.description: Creates and allocates a new report object.

methods.name: CosaReportsInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the report object with default or stored values.

methods.name: CosaReportsRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the report object.
